function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against financial records using last 4 digits of PAN or birth year BEFORE revealing overdue loan or debt details.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit verification code or birth year provided by the caller, e.g., '1234' or '1995'

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay (PTP) date and amount committed by the customer.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

ptp_date.description: The ISO format date or descriptive date agreed upon for payment, e.g. '2026-08-14'

amount.description: The amount in INR the customer committed to pay, e.g., 8499

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers an instant payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered mobile number.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

channel.description: Delivery channel for the payment link

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status in the CRM database.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

notes.description: Additional descriptive notes or context captured during the call

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Transfers call session to a human collections supervisor or grievance officer.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

reason.description: Reason for escalating to human specialist
